interpretation: Static raw-source contract and unsigned algebra; not an ISA interpreter, physical packet capture or external API definition

entry_registers.A1: full32 command; header/checksum ultimately use low8
entry_registers.A2: full32 numeric payload source address; not a lane input

frame.address_rule: Every save/restore uses SP live at that exact instruction; restored words are fresh reads and may have changed through aliasing or opaque callees

lane0: 8A76 compare full32 entryA0 against zero-extended A4; mismatch enters lane1 check
lane1: 8A96 fresh READ16 zero-extended at currentGP+0x9A intoA5
8A9A compares A5 against live full32 S2; mismatch restores/returns
8AB6 setsA5=1;8AB8 setsA2=1 EVEN if the next predicate fails
lane_selection.source_local_lane_after_success: A2 is explicitly0 or1; no opaque calls between lane selection and final tail
lane_selection.callee_identity: The two slot0x4013C callees are opaque; compare-to-one gates do not establish an allocator, permission API, BLE service name or common error semantics

opaque_gate_calls.other_state: A4=first zero-extended handle before call;A5=target;no opaque preservation is assumed

known_local_arguments.A2: entry source address if first gate was not called; otherwise first-gate residue
known_local_arguments.A3: entry length if first gate was not called; otherwise first-gate residue

opaque_gate_calls.other_state: S0/S1/S2/S3/SP/GP may be changed by the first gate; no synthetic ordinary-ABI guarantee

buffer_and_packet_algebra.N: post-gate live S0 used by the payload loop, before the later +6 and fresh restore
buffer_and_packet_algebra.magic_materialization: 8ADE LUI A4,0xFFFF8000;8AE0 XORI A4,-171 => unsigned0x00007F55; not ADDI
buffer_and_packet_algebra.logical_packet_bytes: 55 7F COMMAND_LOW8 LENGTH_HIGH8 LENGTH_LOW8 PAYLOAD_BYTES CHECKSUM_LOW8; this is a local memory layout, not physical wire evidence
buffer_and_packet_algebra.checksum: sum modulo256 of command + low8(length) + (length>>8) + each freshly read payload byte; magic bytes excluded; not a polynomial CRC

payload_loop.guard: 8B0A SLLI A0,A1,16;8B0E SRLI A0,A0,16;8B10 BLTU A0,liveS0 to8B52; compares low16(full32counter) with full32 currentS0
payload_loop.forward_alias_feedback: Every byte is read immediately before its corresponding write. Source/destination/frame overlap is not excluded; a whole-buffer snapshot or memcpy assumption changes this contract
payload_loop.finite_bound_condition: If stable post-gate S0 is <=65535 and accesses complete, loop iterates that many times. Original entry guard guarantees<=1039 only before opaque calls
payload_loop.postgate_S0_above65535: Low16 counter is always smaller; no ordinary terminating guard value. A HOST budget may stop with explicit unknown/budget flow but must not fabricate an original native guard or normal return

failure_return.return_target: fresh saved RA, with JALR target bit0 cleared
A0_path_cases: No opaque gate called: entryA0 remains
First gate returned but second lane is ineligible: first-gate A0 residue remains
Second gate returned non-one: second-gate A0 residue remains
failure_return.A2: Entry address if no gate; first-gate residue if no second call; forced1 after second call even on failure
failure_return.A5_at_failure: Second-handle value on8A9A mismatch,0xFFFE on8AA2 sentinel exclusion,or1 on8ABA predicate failure
failure_return.other_caller_saved_registers: Opaque residues plus explicit local writes; no blanket preservation statement

boundary_arguments.A6: u32(P+N-1) when nonzero payload loop ran; opaque incoming residue when zero-length

success_tail.A6_formula_note: A6 is P+(length-1), the base used with store offset5; it is not the final destination byte address
success_tail.continuation: JALR clears target bit0. Tail callee may return to fresh savedRA, transfer, fault or never return; local code does not normalize its result

limits.callee_nonreturn_rule: Stop the observed prefix on any nonreturn/unknown operation; no fabricated suffix
